views.name: qualified_film_actor_links
views.body_sql:
SELECT fa.film_id AS film, fa.actor_id AS actor, a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_full_name
FROM film_actor fa
JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
views.description: Links each actor to the films they starred in, applying all specified criteria to the film cohort.

views.name: actor_starring_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT actor, actor_full_name, COUNT(film) AS film_count
FROM qualified_film_actor_links
GROUP BY actor, actor_full_name
views.description: Aggregates the linked film-actor pairs to count the number of qualifying films each actor appeared in.
